lines.text: Nahum cries woe to the city of blood, full of lies and plunder, because of her many harlotries.
The LORD of Hosts declares He is against the city and will show her nakedness to the nations.
Thebes, stationed by the Jordan, became an exile, and her nobles were bound in chains.
Nahum says she will become drunk, her fortresses are like fig trees, and her troops are like her women.
Nahum tells the king of Babylon that his shepherds slumber and his people are scattered on the mountains.
